name: cadre-linux-pack
description: CADRE Linux 5-min state diffs — SUID, in-memory exec, listening ports, kernel modules, login users, authorized_keys

suid_bin.query: SELECT path, username, groupname, permissions FROM suid_bin;

proc_inmemory.query: SELECT pid, name, path, cmdline, uid, parent FROM processes WHERE on_disk = 0;

listening_ports_external.query: SELECT pid, port, protocol, family, address, p.name FROM listening_ports lp JOIN processes p USING (pid) WHERE address NOT IN ('127.0.0.1','::1','0.0.0.0','::');

kernel_modules.query: SELECT name, size, used_by, status, address FROM kernel_modules;

login_users.query: SELECT uid, gid, username, description, directory, shell FROM users WHERE shell NOT IN ('/usr/sbin/nologin','/bin/false','/usr/bin/false','/sbin/nologin');

authorized_keys.query: SELECT a.uid, u.username, a.key_file, a.algorithm, a.comment FROM users u JOIN authorized_keys a ON u.uid = a.uid;
